jobs.title: Technical Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Let's be clear about what you're actually signing up for.**
-------------------------------------------------------------


This isn't a traditional Business Analyst role where your primary responsibility is documenting BRDs and handing requirements over to engineering.
At Techdome, Product isn't just documentation it's ownership. You'll work across multiple products in **AI, Healthcare, FinTech, HRMS and Payments domain.**
You'll collaborate directly with Founders, Product, Engineering, Design, QA, and Business teams to define, prioritize, and deliver products that solve real customer problems. **What You'll Do :**  

* Own product features from discovery through production release.
* Gather, analyze, and prioritize business and customer requirements.
* Work closely with engineering teams to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Create and maintain Product Backlogs, User Stories, Epics, and Acceptance Criteria.
* Drive Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Release Planning, and Sprint Reviews.
* Collaborate with Product Designers on wireframes, workflows, and user experiences.
* Define product roadmaps alongside business and engineering stakeholders.
* Conduct requirement workshops and stakeholder discussions.
* Prepare BRDs, FRDs, Functional Specifications, Process Flows, and Product Documentation.
* Coordinate UAT, feature validation, production releases, and post\-release monitoring.
* Analyze customer feedback, product metrics, and business data to recommend improvements.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams throughout the SDLC.
* Leverage AI tools to improve product discovery, documentation, analysis, and productivity.

 **What We're Looking For :**  

* 3\+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, or Product Manager.
* Strong experience working on B2C digital products.
* Excellent understanding of SDLC and Agile product development.
* Experience owning products or major product features end\-to\-end.
* Hands\-on experience with Backlog Management, Sprint Planning, Release Planning, and Product Roadmapping.
* Strong expertise in User Stories, Epics, Acceptance Criteria, BRDs, FRDs, and Process Documentation.
* Experience working with JIRA, Confluence, and product collaboration tools.
* Ability to balance business priorities with technical feasibility.
* Analytical mindset with strong problem\-solving skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced product environment.

 **Bonus Points If You Have :**  

* Strong understanding of REST APIs, SQL, and technical architecture concepts.
* Experience defining product strategy using customer insights and analytics.
* Exposure to AI products, LLMs, or AI\-powered workflows.
* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Gemini.
* Basic knowledge of Prompt Engineering and AI\-assisted product development.
* Ability to analyze product metrics and make data\-driven decisions.

 **What Won't Work Here:**  

* Treating the role as purely documentation\-focused.
* Working in isolation from engineering or business teams.
* Focusing only on delivery instead of customer outcomes.
* Being uncomfortable working across multiple products and domains.

 **Interview Process :**  

* AI Interview on our in\-house platform – JustInterview.ai (JIA)
* Technical \& Functional Discussion
* Leadership Discussion

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer Role
jobs.description:
**This is not a typical Full Stack Developer role.**  

We're not hiring someone to close Jira tickets and write code to spec. We're hiring a **Product Engineer** someone who thinks in terms of architecture, scalability, and customer impact, not just implementation.
At Techdome, engineering means building products that solve real business problems not just shipping features.### **Why This Role Is Different**

  

You'll work across live products spanning **AI, Healthcare, FinTech/Payments, HRM and Automation** collaborating directly with Founders, Product Managers, and Engineering Leaders to take ideas to production. You'll own features end\-to\-end: design, build, ship, monitor, maintain not just develop.  

Key Responsibilities :* Build scalable frontend applications using React.js, Develop backend services using Node.js and Express.js.
* Design secure, scalable, and maintainable REST APIs.
* Build high\-performance data models using MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MySQL.
* Integrate third\-party APIs including payment gateways, AI services, healthcare systems, and enterprise platforms.
* Design scalable authentication and authorization mechanisms.
* Participate in sprint planning, code reviews, architecture discussions, and release planning.
* Leverage AI development tools like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools to improve engineering productivity.

### **What We're Looking For**

* 3\+ years as a Product Engineer, Software Engineer, or Full Stack Developer
* Strong React.js, Node.js, Express.js, JavaScript (ES6\+)
* Hands\-on with MongoDB, PostgreSQL, or MySQL
* Security fundamentals: authentication, authorization, encryption, secure coding
* Experience with JWT, OAuth 2\.0, login/signup flows, session management, RBAC
* Git and collaborative dev workflows; Agile/Scrum experience
* A genuine product mindset ownership and accountability, not just task completion

### **Bonus Points**

* Scalable system architecture and design decisions
* Application security best practices
* Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or other event\-driven systems
* Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, containerized deployments
* AWS, Azure, or GCP

### **This Role Isn't For You If You...**

* Build features without understanding the underlying product or customer problem

**Global Demand Insights Senior Associate (GCF 04\)**

This role will report into the Global Demand Insights Manager, within Amgen’s Capability Center with a focus on integrating global product\-level forecasts, sales and marketing data with regional and country perspectives to identify trends and support country engagement leads in scenario planning to drive alignment between commercial expectations, supply strategies, and the Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process.

jobs.description:
**Overview**
 Every AI agent in Prism needs two things to do real work: an accurate, shared picture of how a customer's business fits together, and a safe way to read from and write back to it. The Prism Platform is that shared foundation, a knowledge layer that describes a customer's business objects and rules, a common way of representing data across different underlying ERP systems, and a structured, per\-customer record that carries context cleanly from one part of the system to another. You own how that foundation evolves: what gets modeled, how it's exposed to the teams and agents that depend on it, and how it gets more accurate and more useful the more it's used.
   

  

 This is a product role at the center of the platform, not on top of it. You will work with the teams building specific AI products and workflows to make sure they get what they need from the platform, and with the engineers building the platform itself to decide what gets prioritized next.
   

  

**Epicor**
 Epicor is a technology leader in ERP software for manufacturing, distribution, and retail, with deep roots in both enterprise software and startup culture. Our product organization is in the middle of a deliberate move to a platform\-first, AI\-enabled delivery model: building shared capabilities that many teams can build on, broadening how roles work together, and removing the silos and handoffs that slow good teams down.
   

  

**How This Team Works**
 The biggest change versus a traditional PM job is how the work gets done. We expect this leader to operate fluently in the model below, and to help the rest of the org adopt it.
   

  

* Built as a platform, not a feature. The Prism Platform exists to be depended on by every other part of Prism. Ease of adoption for the teams building on it, and the quality of the shared foundation it provides, are the real measures of success, not any single feature.
* A small team, not a feature factory. Delivery happens in a lean, cross\-functional team working closely together against a system with built\-in human oversight. You are inside that loop as the product decision\-maker, not reviewing status from the outside.
* Roles blur on a team like this. The lines between product, engineering, design, and architecture blur on a team this size. You work directly in specs, cross\-team sequencing decisions, and real usage data, not a backlog handed over a wall. You keep clear ownership of product scope and decisions while picking up adjacent work that a small team requires.
* Evidence. Decisions about what the platform should model and expose next are grounded in real demand from the teams and agents that depend on it, not opinion. You own the success criteria.
* Reuse before rebuilding. The whole point of a shared foundation is that other teams stop building their own version of the same thing. You own the shared set of building blocks other teams draw from, and keep it coherent as more teams build on it.
* Share openly. Open questions, usage patterns, and outcomes are shared across the org so people can see clearly what the platform can and can't yet promise.


**What We’d Love To See**
* Empathy for two different customers. Real understanding of the end customer whose business data and context flow through the platform, and of the engineering and product teams deciding whether to build on it or work around it. You validate both before committing to a build.
* A platform mindset. You think about ease of adoption, reusable building blocks, and how many teams choose to build on your system the way a good platform product manager thinks about retention, not the way a feature team thinks about a single roadmap.
* Working Backwards: Demonstrates mastery of customer empathy, working backwards from customer pain points to validate the customer problems, ideal customer profiles, and value propositions.
* ‘Founder Mode’ Mindset: Demonstrates an entrepreneurial spirit by taking full ownership, embracing creative problem\-solving, and relentlessly challenging the status quo to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
* Prototyping Pro: Quickly generates prototypes to get early feedback from internal stakeholders and customers.
* Strategic Direction \& Prioritization: Lead the orchestration of strategic direction and set priorities for our AI applications and functionalities. Define the vision and roadmap that drive innovation in AI\-driven products.


**Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Own the platform vision and roadmap. Decide what gets modeled, exposed, and improved next, and keep the roadmap tied to real demand from the teams and products building on it, not to technical completeness for its own sake.
* Own how business context is represented. Define what a customer's business objects, rules, and data look like in a common, structured way, so every team and agent that reads from the platform gets the same, accurate picture regardless of which underlying ERP a customer runs.
* Own the per\-customer context record. Own the structured record that carries a customer's context cleanly from one part of the system to another, so nothing gets lost as work moves between different Prism products.
* Own the read and write\-back loop. Decide what agents and workflows are allowed to write back into the platform as they learn, and how that gets validated, so the foundation improves with use instead of drifting.
* Own the connection to the ERP. Own how the platform exposes ERP data and business logic to the rest of Prism in a consistent way, so other teams build against one clean interface instead of many inconsistent ones.
* Own the catalog of what's built on the platform. Own the system that keeps track of which agents, workflows, and tools exist, what they're allowed to touch, and who's using them, so the platform stays legible as more gets built on it.

**Senior Product Manager Location: Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)** 
**About the Company** 
 At Redpin we simplify life's most important payments. Buying a new property overseas can be a stressful time, especially when it comes to moving your money. Through our Currencies Direct and TorFX brands we've been helping people do just that for over 25 years. With recent investment we're now on a mission to build a new range of digital products and services that will make moving money Internationally for Real Estate purchases even easier. We're on a mission to become the solution for Real Estate payments everywhere. To do this, we are transitioning our business from a horizontal FX platform to a verticalized, embedded software company, as we look to the future and Redpin 2\.0\. As part of this mission, we're thrilled to announce we are open a new office in Hyderabad! We're recruiting for several Engineering roles covering front end (React.js) features.

* Our Operations teams such as Payment Ops, Compliance Ops, Customer Ops \& treasury Ops have multiple portals and we want to unify all of them. There is no dedicated product owner for stakeholder intake.

 We are seeking a Senior Product Manager, Platform to fill this critical gap. This person will be the strategic partner to SRE, Operations and Core Platform Engineering, ensuring the platform runs reliably, the right work gets prioritized, and business stakeholders have a clear intake path.

Overview:

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to play a critical role in strengthening the organization's analytics foundation through business intelligence and data analytics delivery, supported by data discovery and centralization.
This role is accountable for producing high\-quality, scalable analytics and dashboards that support decision\-making, while also improving clarity and consistency across distributed data systems.
The individual in this role serves as a trusted owner of analytical integrity, responsible for defining and maintaining metric logic, validating data availability and definitions, and ensuring analytics are built on clearly understood and well\-documented data sources.
Success requires technical depth, analytical rigor, and the ability to balance day\-to\-day analytics delivery with ongoing data discovery in a decentralized data environment.


Responsibilities:
#### **Business Intelligence and Data Analytics**

* Design, build, and maintain BI dashboards and analytical solutions that support operational, strategic, and ad hoc analytical needs.
* Own metrics and KPIs end\-to\-end, including definition, calculation logic, validation, and ongoing consistency.
* Translate business questions into analytical approaches, dashboards, reports, and supporting data structures.
* Ensure analytics are accurate, well\-documented, and aligned with agreed\-upon metric definitions.
* Provide ongoing analytical support to stakeholders, including investigations, deep dives, and clarification of results.

#### **Data Discovery, Centralization and Documentation**

* Lead data discovery efforts to determine whether required data exists, how it is defined, and where it resides.
* Identify equivalent or related data elements across systems and document authoritative sources.
* Support data centralization and consolidation by identifying overlaps, gaps, and inconsistencies across datasets.
* Create and maintain documentation that supports repeatable analytics, metric consistency, and long\-term scalability.

#### **Data Quality and Accuracy**

* Validate data used in dashboards and analyses to ensure accuracy and reliability.
* Identify data limitations, definition gaps, or quality issues and clearly communicate their impact.
* Promote consistent interpretation and responsible use of metrics across teams.

#### **Cross\-Functional Partnership**

* Create BI dashboards and analytical outputs in close partnership with business, product, and technical teams.
* Serve as a day\-to\-day analytics partner supporting decision\-making through data and insights.
* Communicate analytical findings, assumptions, and limitations clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Operate effectively in environments with evolving documentation and distributed data ownership.


Qualifications:

Required:  

* Advanced degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related discipline.
* Advanced SQL skills with experience querying complex, multi\-schema, multi\-source data environments.
* Strong experience delivering BI dashboards, recurring analytics, and ad hoc analysis for business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience operating in decentralized or federated data environments.
* Experience contributing to data inventories, cataloging efforts, or metric standardization initiatives.
* Hands\-on experience with modern BI and visualization tools (for example, Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent).


Preferred:  

* Experience with data modeling, analytics engineering, or data science practices.
* Exposure to statistical analysis or advanced analytical techniques.
* Familiarity with formal data governance or data quality frameworks.

The ServiceNow Business Systems Analyst plays a strategic role in translating complex business needs into scalable, governed ServiceNow solutions across the enterprise. This role serves as a trusted partner to senior business stakeholders and works closely with ServiceNow Product Owners, Platform teams, and Delivery partners to ensure business demand is clearly articulated, well‑prioritized, and aligned with platform strategy and enterprise standards.


The role will operate with a high degree of autonomy, lead complex discovery efforts, influence solution direction, and ensure delivered outcomes drive measurable business value while maintaining the long‑term health and integrity of the ServiceNow platform.

Key Responsibilities

  

* Strategic Business Engagement
* Serve as a primary point of contact for business stakeholders, owning end‑to‑end requirement discovery for complex or cross‑domain initiatives.
* Lead structured discovery sessions to understand business objectives, operational pain points, risks, and desired outcomes.
* Provide thought leadership to business partners on how they can leverage ServiceNow capabilities to simplify processes and improve efficiency.

  

* Requirement Translation \& Communication
* Bridge communication between business stakeholders and ServiceNow Product, Platform, and Engineering teams.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Anticipate downstream impacts across data, integrations, reporting, and operating processes.

  

* Solution Alignment
* Work closely with ServiceNow Product Owners to support backlog readiness, refinement, and prioritization.
* Partner with ServiceNow Product \& Platform teams to ensure proposed solutions:
* Align to out‑of‑the‑box ServiceNow capabilities.
* Meet enterprise governance, security, and compliance standards.
* Consider long\-term platform sustainability.
* Support solution evaluation by assessing business tradeoffs, risks, and value considerations.

  

* Delivery Lifecycle Leadership
* Act as the business subject matter expert throughout the delivery lifecycle, from intake through UAT and deployment.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, providing clarity on business intent and validating delivered functionality.
* Manage scope, dependencies, and expectation alignment across stakeholders.
* Process Improvement \& Governance
* Document current‑state and future‑state business processes and workflows.
* Identify opportunities to streamline, standardize, and optimize business processes using ServiceNow.
* Contributes to improving intake models, requirement standards, and governance processes.

  

Must‑Have Qualifications

* 8\+ years of experience as a Business Systems Analyst in enterprise technology environments.
* 4\-5 years of hands\-on experience working with ServiceNow, operating in a functional or techno‑functional capacity across one or more modules (e.g., CMDB, ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM).
* Deep understanding of CMDB and CSDM with Data quality and business rules enhancements.
* Experience in defining Resiliency boundaries in CMDB.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior business stakeholders.
* Deep understanding of ServiceNow concepts, including workflows, data structures, roles, integrations, and reporting.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly and concisely.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps automation
* Proven ability to work in offshore–onshore delivery models, collaborating across multiple time zones with global teams.

  

Required Qualifications

* Experience operating within Agile delivery models.
* + Strong analytical and structured problem‑solving abilities.
* + Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and ambiguity.
* + Experience producing high‑quality artifacts, including:
* + Business and functional requirements
* + User stories and acceptance criteria
* + Process flows and impact assessments.
* Preferred Certifications
* + Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) or PMI\-PBA – Preferred
* + ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) – Plus

 SmartWheels builds GPS tracking and fleet monitoring apps and web platforms for the US market. Our hardware and software portfolio includes OBD2 trackers, asset trackers, BLE tags, and a phone\-based SDK tracker, with new product lines added regularly. One of the fast growing companies in Xemplar Group.
 



 Role Summary
 



 As BA, you'll own requirement discovery and documentation across SmartWheels' multi\-product line from hardware based telematics to hardware less IOT solutions. You'll write and refine user stories for frontend, backend and web workstreams, run sprint ceremonies alongside the Scrum Master/PM, and act as the day\-to\-day bridge between business stakeholders, customers, and engineering.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Gather and analyze requirements from stakeholders, customers, and support/sales teams across all product lines
 



 • Write clear, well\-structured user stories and acceptance criteria for frontend, backend, and web features; maintain the product backlog in Jira.
 



 • Break down epics into sprint\-ready stories; support sprint planning, estimation, backlog grooming, daily stand\-ups, sprint review, and retrospectives.
 



 • Create and maintain process flows, wireframe annotations, and functional specs (BRDs/FRDs) for new features and integrations.

 Required Skills \& Experience
 



 • 5\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in a software product company; SaaS, IoT, telematics, or fleet/GPS tracking domain strongly preferred.
 



 • Proven track record writing user stories and acceptance criteria for frontend, backend, and web platforms.
 



 • Hands\-on expertise with Jira for backlog management, sprint boards, and reporting; comfortable configuring workflows and epics/stories/subtasks.
 



 • Experience in actively running Agile/Scrum – sprint planning, grooming, daily stand\-ups, reviews, retrospectives.
 



 • Enough technical fluency to read API/data specs, understand device\-to\-cloud data flow and hold your own in engineering discussions – no coding required.
 



 • Strong written and verbal communication; Should be comfortable to work in fast paced culture ,able to work directly with US\-based stakeholders and adjust for time\-zone overlap.
 



 • Experience with wireframing tools (Figma, Miro, Lucidchart, or similar) and documentation tools (Confluence or equivalent).

 • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, business, or related field.
 



 Good to Have
 



 • Prior experience with GPS/telematics, IoT hardware products, or fleet management software.
 



 • Exposure to mobile app (iOS/Android) requirement writing in addition to web.
 



 • CBAP, PSPO, or CSPO certification.
 



 • Preparing PowerBI or tableau dashboards \& analytics Work Location \& Hours

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Amazon Pharmacy's Supply Chain Engineering team in Bangalore and build the systems that determine how medications reach patients. You will design and develop ML\-driven supply chain technology: demand forecasting models that predict prescription volume, procurement systems that optimize purchasing under expiry and regulatory constraints, placement algorithms that position inventory across fulfillment centers, and planning systems that allocate capacity to meet patient demand. You will work at the intersection of software engineering, operations research, and machine learning.  

  

This is a founding team. You will build new systems from scratch, not maintain legacy code. You will work with large\-scale datasets, ML models in production, and distributed systems that must be highly available because medication access depends on them. Pharmacy supply chains are unlike retail: demand is driven by prescriptions (not browsing), products expire, controlled substances require compliance layers, and regulations vary by state. Every system you build operates under these constraints.  

  

We are building an AI\-native engineering team. You will use AI\-augmented development workflows daily: code generation, automated testing, AI\-assisted code review. We expect engineers who learn fast, build smart, and own their systems end\-to\-end from design through production operations.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

A. System Design \& Development  

* Design and build scalable, resilient services for supply chain optimization: forecasting, procurement, placement, or planning
* Develop ML\-integrated systems that improve over time: learned demand models, intelligent reorder logic, placement optimization
* Write high\-quality, well\-tested code and participate actively in code reviews
* Implement operations research techniques in production: optimization solvers, simulation engines, probabilistic demand models, safety stock calculations
* Follow supply chain engineering best practices: backtesting against historical data, offline evaluation before deployment, experiment design for measuring real\-world supply chain impact
* Build data pipelines that process large\-scale pharmacy supply chain signals: prescription fills, supplier lead times, inventory positions, drug expiry dates


B. Operational Ownership  

* Own the systems you build end\-to\-end: design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and oncall
* Build robust observability: metrics, alarms, dashboards that surface supply chain health in real time
* Participate in oncall rotations and drive root\-cause analysis for production issues
* Design for failure: implement graceful degradation, circuit breakers, and fallback strategies for mission\-critical services


C. Collaboration \& Growth  

* Partner with Applied Scientists to productionize ML models and experimentation frameworks
* Work with product managers to translate business problems into technical designs
* Collaborate across time zones with US\-based teams on priorities, design reviews, and operational handoffs
* Contribute to a learning culture: share knowledge, mentor peers, and drive engineering best practices


D. Innovation  

* Leverage AI tools to accelerate development velocity and improve code quality
* Identify opportunities for automation and ML within your domain
* Propose and execute on technical improvements that reduce operational toil or improve system performance
* Stay current with advances in supply chain ML, optimization, and distributed systems
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 5\+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5\+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* 5\+ years working in a Supply Chain or related Operations domain with a focus on ML based applications.

jobs.title: Product Manager -AI
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

Every AI agent in Prism needs two things to do real work: an accurate, shared picture of how a customer's business fits together, and a safe way to read from and write back to it. The Prism Platform is that shared foundation, a knowledge layer that describes a customer's business objects and rules, a common way of representing data across different underlying ERP systems, and a structured, per\-customer record that carries context cleanly from one part of the system to another. You own how that foundation evolves: what gets modeled, how it's exposed to the teams and agents that depend on it, and how it gets more accurate and more useful the more it's used.


This is a product role at the center of the platform, not on top of it. You will work with the teams building specific AI products and workflows to make sure they get what they need from the platform, and with the engineers building the platform itself to decide what gets prioritized next.


**Epicor**
----------

Epicor is a technology leader in ERP software for manufacturing, distribution, and retail, with deep roots in both enterprise software and startup culture. Our product organization is in the middle of a deliberate move to a platform\-first, AI\-enabled delivery model: building shared capabilities that many teams can build on, broadening how roles work together, and removing the silos and handoffs that slow good teams down.


**How This Team Works**
-----------------------

The biggest change versus a traditional PM job is how the work gets done. We expect this leader to operate fluently in the model below, and to help the rest of the org adopt it.


* **Built as a platform, not a feature.** The Prism Platform exists to be depended on by every other part of Prism. Ease of adoption for the teams building on it, and the quality of the shared foundation it provides, are the real measures of success, not any single feature.

* **A small team, not a feature factory.** Delivery happens in a lean, cross\-functional team working closely together against a system with built\-in human oversight. You are inside that loop as the product decision\-maker, not reviewing status from the outside.
* **Roles blur on a team like this.** The lines between product, engineering, design, and architecture blur on a team this size. You work directly in specs, cross\-team sequencing decisions, and real usage data, not a backlog handed over a wall. You keep clear ownership of product scope and decisions while picking up adjacent work that a small team requires.
* **Evidence.** Decisions about what the platform should model and expose next are grounded in real demand from the teams and agents that depend on it, not opinion. You own the success criteria.
* **Reuse before rebuilding.** The whole point of a shared foundation is that other teams stop building their own version of the same thing. You own the shared set of building blocks other teams draw from, and keep it coherent as more teams build on it.
* **Share openly.** Open questions, usage patterns, and outcomes are shared across the org so people can see clearly what the platform can and can't yet promise.

**What We’d Love to See**
-------------------------

* **Empathy for two different customers.** Real understanding of the end customer whose business data and context flow through the platform, and of the engineering and product teams deciding whether to build on it or work around it. You validate both before committing to a build.
* **A platform mindset.** You think about ease of adoption, reusable building blocks, and how many teams choose to build on your system the way a good platform product manager thinks about retention, not the way a feature team thinks about a single roadmap.
* **Working Backwards:** Demonstrates mastery of customer empathy, working backwards from customer pain points to validate the customer problems, ideal customer profiles, and value propositions.
* **‘Founder Mode’ Mindset:** Demonstrates an entrepreneurial spirit by taking full ownership, embracing creative problem\-solving, and relentlessly challenging the status quo to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
* **Prototyping Pro:** Quickly generates prototypes to get early feedback from internal stakeholders and customers.
* **Strategic Direction \& Prioritization:** Lead the orchestration of strategic direction and set priorities for our AI applications and functionalities. Define the vision and roadmap that drive innovation in AI\-driven products.

**Duties \& Responsibilities**
------------------------------

**Early\-career: 1\-3 years of experience.** 




  





 Compensation isn’t determined by the salary band in the job posting. It’s determined by the value you bring. We pay top\-of\-market compensation to top\-of\-market talent.
 



  





**Who we are** 




  





 LiveSwitch builds video and communication technology for small businesses: virtual estimates, on\-site documentation, and AI built for the trades. We help David slay Goliath. Our products help small businesses save money, make money, and serve their customers better.
 



 The company is owned and led by Brian Hamilton, who has built major companies before. The model here is simple: hire exceptionally smart, driven people, give them real ownership from day one, and move fast. We are growing our product team in Bangalore, and this role offers real ownership of products that paying customers use every day.
 



  





**What a PM is here** 




  





 Not what you've read on LinkedIn. At LiveSwitch, the foundation of product management is knowing the product and the customer better than anyone else in the building. The way you get there is by
 **testing the product harder and better than anyone else** 
 . You will use our products the way customers use them, every day, until you feel what they feel. You will find what's broken before customers do. You will watch real customers use our software and turn what you see into improvements that ship in days, not quarters.
 



  





 Strategy comes later, and it comes from this: the person with the best data makes the decision, and you will have the best data because you did the work.
 



  





**Read this before you apply** 




  





 We recruit the way we'd want to be recruited: everything on the table, first date.
 


* **The hours are long.** 
 60\+ hour weeks are normal here. There is a cost to building something big. If you want balance right now, that's a legitimate choice, and this is the wrong job for it.
* **Your first months are in the product, not in decks.** 
 Testing, watching customers, finding and driving fixes. If that sounds beneath a PM to you, we disagree about what a PM is, and you shouldn't apply.
* **Deadlines are assumed to be now.** 
 No status meetings, no long threads. You get an objective, you own it, you move.
* **Feedback is direct.** 
 We are brutal about facts, so we can be fast about fixes. You'll get plain\-spoken feedback and you're expected to give it, including to leadership. Arguing with leaders using better data is how you earn stature here.
* **Everything is measured.** 
 Bugs found, focus groups run, improvements shipped. You'll have clear numbers that are visible.
* **Titles mean nothing.** 
 Respect is earned by what you do.



 If that list made you tired, please don't apply, sincerely and with respect. If it made you lean forward, keep reading.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




  




* Test our products the way customers use them, daily, and own the quality of what ships.
* Run customer focus groups: watch real users, see where they get caught, find out why.
* Turn findings into shipped improvements: you drive fixes and features end\-to\-end with engineering.
* Own measurable goals and report against them like an owner.
* Work directly with the owner and senior leaders of the company from week one.



  





**Who you are** 




  




* **1\-3 years of experience** 
 where you shipped or materially improved something real.
* **A finder.** 
 In past work, you caught what others missed (bugs, broken flows, wrong numbers) because not finding it bothered you. You'll be asked for specific stories.
* **Top of your class from a top\-tier school** 
 , with a record to show it.
* **You come with answers.** 
 Given a problem, you return a position and a reason, not a framework and four options.
* **You write and speak with clarity** 
 , and you say "I don't know" when you don't.



  





**The process** 




  





 Fast: measured in days, not months.
 


1. **Screen** 
 with a member of the Product team (45 min).
2. **Work sample** 
 : We give you access to a LiveSwitch product. You test it hard for 48 hours and bring us your ranked findings and top improvements, then defend them live.
3. **Conversation with Brian Hamilton** 
 , owner of LiveSwitch. Yes, really, and yes, early. He meets candidates himself.
4. **Deep dive** 
 with one of our senior product managers.
5. Offer, with a written, explicit summary of exactly what you're signing up for. No surprises. That's the whole point.

* Sprint Planning Backlog Grooming
* Requirement Analysis: Review user stories and actively participate in "three amigos" sessions (Developer, Product Owner, and QA) to define clear, testable acceptance criteria.
* Test Estimation: Estimate the time and effort required for manual testing, test data preparation, and defect logging.
* Risk Identification: Proactively highlight potential edge cases, risks, and dependencies early in the sprint.
* Test Design Execution
* Test Case Creation: Design and document detailed, reusable test cases and update the Requirement Traceability Matrix (RTM).
* Exploratory Testing: Utilize user personas and domain expertise to conduct deep, unscripted \[exploratory testing](0\.5\.1, 0\.5\.5\) to catch complex, edge\-case bugs that traditional test scripts miss.
* Continuous Testing: Test stories continuously throughout the sprint rather than waiting for an all\-encompassing, end\-of\-cycle testing phase.
* Defect Management Collaboration
* Bug Triage: Log reproducible, detailed defect reports in tools like Jira, ADO and collaborate with developers during triage meetings to prioritize fixes.
* Regression Retesting: Verify bug fixes and run targeted regression tests to ensure new code changes haven't broken existing functionalities.
* Quality Advocacy: Promote a culture where quality is a shared, team\-wide responsibility rather than a bottleneck handled solely by QA.
* Agile Ceremonies Continuous Improvement
* Daily Stand\-ups: Provide updates on testing progress, unblock developers, and flag any risks that might impact sprint velocity.
* Sprint Retrospectives: Suggest improvements to the agile testing process, advocate for better tooling or pipelines, and help optimize the team's workflow.
* Sprint Demos UAT Support: Assist the Product Owner and business stakeholders in evaluating software against the user story's original goals during sprint reviews. \[]
* Test Automation Technical Expertise: Oversee the development of automated testing frameworks and scripts to improve testing efficiency.
* Collaboration: Act as a single point of contact between testers, developers, business analysts, and stakeholders, providing test estimates and results reporting.
* Environment Data Management: Oversee the setup of testing environments and ensure appropriate test data is available.

* Proficiency in manual and automated testing tools.
* Strong knowledge of SQL for database validation.

**About the Role**

As a DevOps Engineer, you will design, implement, and enhance our modern DevSecOps ecosystem. You will work closely under the guidance of the Senior DevOps Engineer to build secure, scalable CI/CD pipelines, automate cloud infrastructure, and integrate AI‑driven security and operational practices.


This role is hands‑on, requiring strong technical skills, a passion for automation, and an eagerness to adopt cutting‑edge technologies including generative AI and AI‑augmented DevSecOps tools. jobs.description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**The Infrastructure Quality Team**



Okta's Infrastructure Quality team is the resilient and frictionless foundation for our global platforms. We are stewards of system integrity, ensuring that our infrastructure is built with the scalability to grow, the security to trust, and the velocity to innovate. We partner closely with Shared Infrastructure Services and Technical Operations to deliver a "zero\-touch" autonomous infrastructure, driving quality, resilience, and reliability across our Core/Resiliency, Data Platform, Technical Operations, and Engineering Security groups.

  


**The Infrastructure Quality Manager Opportunity**



As an Infrastructure Quality Manager, you will lead a high\-impact team at the center of Okta's "Always On" mission. You will be responsible for defining and executing quality strategies across our critical infrastructure pillars, including Core/Resiliency, Data Platform, and Tech Ops/EngSec. We operate as a force multiplier: we don’t just test everything; we enable our partners to perform risk\-based, automated validation. You will lead the transition from manual, reactive testing to AI\-driven, autonomous validation, ensuring our infrastructure remains robust under extreme demands.

  


**What You’ll Be Doing**


* Manage and grow a high\-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of technical excellence and career development.
* Partner with leaders in Core/Resiliency, Data Platform, Tech Ops, and EngSec to implement automated quality guardrails and "Definition of Done" standards.
* Drive the "Zero\-Touch" automation strategy, utilizing AI\-driven tools to predict failures, identify hotspots, and streamline release readiness.
* Oversee operational readiness initiatives and provide on\-call incident management support
* Provide technical guidance on infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) reviews, ensuring resource limits, scalability, and performance targets are met.
* Act as a Customer and Security Advocate, ensuring quality thinking is embedded into every design decision, review, and release.
* Evaluate existing systems and new technologies (e.g., A/B scale testing, Kubernetes, Cloud native services) to evolve our infrastructure quality roadmap.

  


**What You’ll Bring To The Role**


* Strong management experience in a distributed, global environment; experience managing teams in Bangalore is highly preferred.
* Proven experience in infrastructure quality, SRE, or platform engineering, with a focus on resiliency and performance at scale.
* Deep understanding of Cloud/SaaS Infrastructure (AWS/GCP) and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
* Expertise in observability and monitoring stacks (e.g., Splunk, Grafana) and their role in incident recovery and diagnostics.
* Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform) and test automation frameworks for non\-deterministic/data\-heavy environments.
* Strategic mindset: Ability to partner with Architects, Product Owners, and Security Engineers to influence design and strategy, not just execution.

jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and highly driven
 **Product Owner** 
 to lead the strategy, planning, development, and adoption of enterprise digital and AI\-powered products. The ideal candidate will work closely with customers, business stakeholders, engineering, UX, sales, and leadership teams to identify market opportunities, translate business challenges into scalable product capabilities, and ensure successful delivery of secure, high\-quality products.
   

  

 The successful candidate should be equally comfortable defining product strategy and vision while driving execution through Agile delivery teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy \& Roadmap**
* Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, value proposition, and roadmap.
* Identify customer pain points, market opportunities, industry trends, and competitive differentiators.
* Translate business objectives into measurable product initiatives.
* Prioritize product investments based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, and strategic goals.
* Build business cases for new features, products, and market expansion opportunities.
* Collaborate with leadership on product packaging, pricing, commercialization, and go\-to\-market strategies.


**Customer \& Market Discovery**
* Engage with customers, sales teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and business challenges.
* Conduct discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, product demonstrations, and feedback sessions.
* Convert customer\-specific requirements into scalable product capabilities.
* Analyze competitor products and market trends to identify opportunities for innovation.
* Validate ideas through prototypes, pilots, proof\-of\-concepts, and customer feedback.


**Product Ownership \& Agile Delivery**
* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and roadmap.
* Create and maintain epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and functional specifications.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering, Architecture, UX, QA, DevOps, Security, and Data teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Provide functional clarifications and prioritization decisions during development.
* Review and accept completed features based on agreed acceptance criteria.
* Balance new feature development with platform stability, technical debt, performance, and security improvements.


**Product Launch \& Adoption**
* Coordinate successful product releases with engineering, support, sales, marketing, documentation, and customer success teams.
* Prepare product documentation, release notes, feature briefs, presentations, and training materials.
* Support customer demonstrations, workshops, proposals, pilots, and pre\-sales activities.
* Work closely with sales and customer success teams to increase product adoption, customer retention, and business growth.
* Gather post\-release feedback and incorporate insights into future roadmap planning.


**Product Performance \& Governance**
* Define and monitor key product success metrics, including adoption, usage, customer satisfaction, retention, revenue, and operational performance.
* Leverage product analytics and customer feedback to continuously improve the product.
* Track roadmap progress, risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones.
* Ensure compliance with security, privacy, regulatory, accessibility, and enterprise governance standards.
* Collaborate with Legal, Finance, Procurement, Security, and Compliance teams where necessary.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of professional experience, including 3\+ years as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, or similar product\-focused role.
* Proven experience managing enterprise software, SaaS platforms, AI products, workflow applications, or digital solutions.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and the complete product development lifecycle.
* Experience defining product roadmaps, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications.
* Good understanding of software architecture, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, security, deployment models, and data flows.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Strong analytical thinking with the ability to prioritize competing business needs.
* Experience working with cross\-functional and geographically distributed teams.

* We’re looking for someone to support senior management in driving the development of our digital payment product priorities and investment needs

* This is an opportunity to oversee the service delivery of our pricing and billing capability set, making sure all aspects of our digital customer journey deliver an exceptional customer experience

 We’re looking for someone to own the digital journey, driving aspects like performance management, service proposition and customer experience. You’ll be setting the vision for a whole host of features relating to pricing and billing, making sure that we create a world\-class digital experience for our customers.  In this role, you’ll need to have previous experience of working in a Scrum or Agile team. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Technical Product Owner
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  

**Business \& Team:**
 The
 **Non\-Human Identity (NHI) Platform \& Resilience Team** 
 within Identity \& Access Technology (IAT), Group Security, is responsible for delivering and operating the enterprise capabilities that manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of Non\-Human Identities.
   

  

 The team enables secure provisioning, ownership management, access governance, certification, modification, and decommissioning of machine identities, including service accounts, shared accounts, robotic accounts, and other system identities. In addition, the team is responsible for building resilient, scalable, and automated platform services that support identity operations, governance, compliance, and operational excellence.
   

  

 The Identity \& Access Technology (IAT) team protects the Bank and our customers from cyber compromise, through proactive management of cyber security, privacy, and operational risk. Our team includes: \- Cyber Protection \& Design ,Cyber Delivery ,Identity \& Access Assurance
   

  

**Impact \& Contribution:**
 To ensure the Group achieves sustainable competitive advantage through engineering teams, you will need to play a key role in supporting and executing the Groups data strategy. As a Technical Product Owner, you are:
   

  

* Empathetic and self\-aware. You think and care deeply about how you might interact with your team, stakeholders, and customers.
* A Mentor, harbouring a passion to nurture, grow and influence those around you to think differently and always maintain a growth mindset.
* Innovative. You continually seek to improve the status quo for our customers. You inspire your team to do the same and remain resilient through change.
* Promoting quality and delivering at pace through the maximization of automation is one of the key focus areas of the role.
* Ownership, you take responsibility for the software design, engineering processes and quality standards of yours as well as your team members as you work in a collaborative environment.


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
 As the Technical Product Owner for the NHI Platform \& Resilience Crew, you will be responsible to act as Act as a trusted leader within the Identity Domain, influencing strategic direction, driving alignment across crews, fostering innovation, and building strong relationships across engineering, risk, operations, and business stakeholders:
   

  

* Define and monitor product success measures, adoption metrics, operational KPIs, resilience objectives, and customer outcomes.
* Continuously evaluate product performance and use data\-driven insights to optimise investment decisions and roadmap priorities.
* Define and own the strategic vision, roadmap, objectives, and outcomes for the NHI Platform and Agentic Identity capabilities.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager I ( Product Owner- Sports Products)
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about powering a better media future for all people by providing powerful, essential insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content—wherever and whenever it's consumed.
   

  

 Gracenote, a Nielsen Company, is the world's leading provider of entertainment metadata and content IDs. We sit at the intersection of media, technology, and data, helping the world's largest entertainment brands connect people to the content they love.
   

  

 Gracenote Sports is a global operation that collects, manages, and delivers live results and comprehensive sports data across all major global and local leagues—from the Premier League, NFL, and Formula 1 to the Olympics and IPL—serving customers who rely on accurate, real\-time sports information.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a hands\-on product owner to support the Gracenote Sports product team in building, consolidating, and delivering our sports data and product ecosystem. In this role, you will work closely with the lead Product Manager to ensure development teams have well\-defined backlogs, clear priorities, and a deep understanding of the "what" and "why" behind their work. Critically, you will also serve as the bridge between product strategy and engineering execution—able to understand and communicate the "how" in both directions.
   

  

 Gracenote Sports is at a pivotal point: unifying legacy platforms into a single, consolidated database and tooling ecosystem, while simultaneously designing a data model capable of representing the full diversity of global sports and competition formats—and delivering that data through customer\-facing products (Global Sports Data API, Global Sports Widgets). This role will be instrumental in accelerating that transformation by embedding product ownership directly within engineering teams and ensuring day\-to\-day delivery stays aligned with the broader sports product roadmap.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines a genuine passion for sports with strong product ownership fundamentals—someone who thrives in the detail of backlog management, ticket creation, grooming, and testing while maintaining sight of the bigger picture across platform, data pipelines, and frontend delivery products.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own and manage backlogs for one or more engineering squads: translate PRDs and roadmap priorities into well\-structured engineering tickets with clear acceptance criteria, and keep backlogs prioritized and ready for development.
* Conduct grooming and sprint planning sessions with engineering teams; ensure teams understand what they are building, why it matters, and how it fits the broader roadmap.
* Serve as a two\-way translator between product and engineering: communicate product intent to developers, and explain technical approach and trade\-offs back to stakeholders.
* Perform hands\-on testing and validation of tooling, data pipeline, and product changes, ensuring quality and correctness before release.
* Work flexibly across multiple teams and product areas—including the data collection tooling team (Mumbai), the data platform team, the data processing team, and the frontend delivery products (Global Sports Data API, Global Sports Widgets)—providing product ownership where it is most needed.
* Challenge existing technical approaches and legacy patterns. Bring alternative perspectives to engineering discussions and push teams to consider better, more scalable solutions rather than defaulting to the status quo.
* Develop a solid understanding of the full sports product portfolio, the various sports and competition formats being modeled, and the data flows from collection through to customer\-facing product delivery.
* Support migration and consolidation efforts by helping define requirements for data migration, tool unification, database integration, and data model design that accommodates diverse sports and competition formats.


**A Day in the Life**
 Your morning starts with a standup for one of the platform teams. A developer has questions about how a new competition format (say, a multi\-stage cycling race) should be represented in the data model—you pull up the PRD, walk through the expected behavior, and sketch out the edge cases together.
   

  

 Mid\-morning, you're grooming tickets for the next sprint with a different squad working on the Global Sports Data API. You challenge a proposed approach that mirrors a legacy pattern: "Why are we doing it this way? Could we handle this more generically so it works for athletics too?" The engineer pushes back, you discuss trade\-offs, and together you land on a better solution.
   

  

 After lunch, you're testing a tooling release with the Mumbai team—clicking through the data entry workflows, verifying that the new football league they onboarded last week flows correctly from collection tool to database to API output. You find an edge case, log a bug with clear reproduction steps, and flag it before it ships.
   

  

 Late afternoon, you sync with the lead Product Manager. You report back on where the teams are, flag a dependency between the platform team and the widget team, and discuss whether a migration milestone needs to shift. You translate engineering's "we need two more sprints because of X" into language that makes sense for the roadmap discussion and improvements to avoid a shift in the future.
   

  

 Between meetings, you're scanning the backlog—re\-prioritizing based on what you learned today, writing acceptance criteria for a ticket that was too vague, and archiving stories that are no longer relevant.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 3–5\+ years of experience in a product management or product owner role, ideally within a data\-intensive or platform\-oriented environment.

**Your Job**
We are seeking a Data Analyst to support Data Quality (DQ) and Master Data Management (MDM) activities that enable reliable business processes and data\-driven decision making. In this role, you will work closely with business users, data stewards, and technology teams to help maintain accurate and trusted data across enterprise systems. You will have opportunities to analyze data, resolve issues, improve processes, and contribute to data governance initiatives.

**Our Team**


You will join a collaborative team focused on improving data quality and maintaining trusted master data that supports key business operations. The team partners closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure enterprise data remains accurate, consistent, and actionable.

**What You Will Do**  

  



* Improve business decision\-making by monitoring data quality metrics, reports, and exception trends.
* Perform data profiling, validation, and reconciliation activities to identify and remediate data quality issues.
* Support root\-cause investigations and drive resolution of data quality incidents and remediation actions.
* Assist with developing and maintaining data quality rules, controls, and validation processes.
* Create, update, and maintain master data records, including customer, material, and reference data.
* Execute approved master data changes within ERP and MDM platforms while ensuring compliance with data standards.
* Conduct quality reviews before and after master data updates to maintain data integrity.
* Build and maintain Excel\-based reports, dashboards, and data validation tools.
* Write SQL queries to analyze data, identify trends, and support issue resolution.
* Support data migration, testing, and validation activities for system enhancements and business projects.
* Document findings, business rules, and process improvements while effectively communicating results to stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business partners to identify opportunities to improve data quality and master data processes.

  

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**
  

* 1\-3 years of experience in Data analysis, Data quality, Master data management, reporting, data governance, or related data management functions.
* Experience using Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, formulas, charts, and data analysis features.
* Experience writing SQL queries using joins, filtering, aggregation, and data retrieval techniques.
* Experience analyzing, validating, or reconciling data sets.
* Knowledge of data quality, data governance, or data management concepts.
* Experience working with large datasets from multiple sources.
* Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate with cross\-functional teams.

  

**What Will Put You Ahead**
  

* Experience gained through internships, academic projects, or professional work involving data analysis or reporting.
* Experience supporting data quality, master data, or data governance initiatives.
* Exposure to ERP systems, including SAP.
* Familiarity with Master Data Management (MDM) concepts and processes.
* Experience using Power Query or other data transformation tools.
* Experience supporting data migrations, testing, or system implementation projects.

jobs.description:
Riskonnect, Inc. is the leading integrated risk management software solution provider that empowers organizations to predict, manage and respond in real\-time to strategic and operational risks across the extended enterprise. Riskonnect is the only provider ranked in the leadership and visionary quadrants by world\-renowned industry analysts Gartner and Forrester. We employ over 500 risk professionals in the Americas, EMEA, and the Asia Pacific and serve over 900 customers across six continents. Innovative risk technology, a customer success mindset, and employee\-first belief make Riskonnect a sought\-after place to work.
   

  

 Reasonable Accommodations Statement
   

  

 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential functions satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 The Business Intelligence Analyst handles meeting customers’ reporting, and analytics needs through the deployment and support of standard and custom solutions. The role requires gathering customers’ business requirements and designing solutions based on an understanding of the customers’ data and reporting solutions used to build the outputs.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Demonstrate capabilities of customer support and consulting skills, such as problem solving, influencing, and occasionally delivering presentations to mainly internal but also potential customer audiences
* Elicit requirements from internal and external stakeholders using various methods, such as interviews, document analysis, and product analysis, and create functional specifications.
* Support Q\&A from other members of the development team on the specification they have created.
* Directs the functional aspect of the day\-to\-day sprint team work
* Perform acceptance testing on features they have designed, to ensure the features deliver the expected business value/result
* Maintain high level knowledge of the entire application, and be an expert resource on the functional behavior of at least one module/area of the system.
* Serve to provide usability perspective and direction to the development team, in conjunction with customers and User Experience designers
* Maintain working knowledge of the industry and product domain


**Position Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in technical or highly numerate degree educated in IT Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology field equivalent or risk management\-based degree, and/or other relevant qualifications
* Typically requires 5\+ years of experience in business analysis with increasing responsibilities and project complexities
* Some work experience in a similar or related area is preferred
* Some experience of SQL and data visualization or other preferred reporting solution.
* Examples might be Domo, Tableau, ‘Power BI’, Cognos, Business Objects, or similar
* Interest in best practice and innovative requirements gathering and data visualization design
* Strong interpersonal, communication, analytical, quantitative and problem\-solving skills are essential
* Ability to reason through logic problems and apply creative thinking, with a strong attention to detail
* Ability to work under pressure and meet multiple deadlines
* Self\-starter, able to work independently whilst contributing to a team environment based in other countries
* Occasional out of hours work may be needed if critical issues arise.


 PHYSICAL DEMANDS
   

  

 Physical Requirements: While performing the duties of this position, the employee must regularly talk or hear. The employee often must use hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls. The employee must occasionally stand; walk; sit; and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
